n10_subtask: N10.3 independent calibration under removed project-added localization quality/freshness thresholds
hypothesis: With the project-added VINS quality and localization/odometry receipt-age lockouts removed from runtime, the same single-D435i 16 m 3D/yaw EGO mission can execute and produce complete raw VIO, map, tracking, contact, PX4, and long-hold measurements without a project health threshold ending the run.
sole_runtime_factor_changed_from_357: Project-added localization quality/freshness gate implementation: #357 used a run-local bypass around the old gates; #361 removes the gate policy from the runtime path and keeps raw metrics observational. The planner profile, spawn, route, goal, EGO collision policy, PX4 setup, and observer set are held fixed.

task.route: one +16.0 m ENU / +0.10 m / +0.20 rad single goal; 3 s native dwell; 600 simulated-second ACTIVE post-goal hold; then bridge-owned landing
task.contact_overlay: read-only observation; no collision geometry change

localization_policy.historical_reference_use: offline description only; no runtime lockout or pass/fail gate
retained_integrity_constraints: valid message structure and finite coordinates

other_retained_runtime_rules: PX4 bridge sole control publisher and its control/watchdog behavior

acceptance.classification: diagnostic calibration only; not N11-N16 formal qualification and does not freeze N10.3 thresholds
required_observations: one action goal sent and native action completion
independent PX4/bridge readback LANDED or DISABLED, landed=true, armed=false, control_enabled=false, vehicle_remained_disarmed=true, control_samples_zero=true
acceptance.all_error/age/tracking/clearance/cost va: report measurements only; no new acceptance threshold is applied

run_commands.safe_stop: bash tools/project.sh stop n10-20261027-361-quality-gates-removed-speed080-16m only after the independent PX4/bridge terminal readback in the run driver confirms safe_to_stop_project_container=true
